# Empty state

> A centered placeholder with an optional icon for lists and views that have nothing to show yet.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.empty-state`
- Source: `src/ui/empty_state.cljc`
- Public fns: `empty-state-class-list`, `empty-state-classes`, `empty-state`
- Keywords: empty state, no results, placeholder, zero state

## When to use

- A list, search or filter returned nothing.
- A feature not set up yet, with one next step.

## When not to use

- Use skeleton while content is still loading.
- Use alert for an error that prevented loading.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.empty-state :as empty-state])

(empty-state/empty-state {:icon :inbox}
  [:p "No projects yet"]
  [:p.text-muted "Projects you create or join appear here."]
  (button/button {:variant :primary :icon-left :plus} "Create project"))
```

## API reference

### `empty-state`

A centered column with muted text and an optional large icon above.

Children: Title, description and at most one action.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:icon` | `icon keyword` | – | Rendered at :xl above the content. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `empty-state-classes`

Class string.

### `empty-state-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Say why it is empty and what to do next in text; the icon is decorative.

## Motion

- None.

## Responsive behavior

- Fills its region with generous padding; keep copy to two short lines.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Title: No projects yet. Description: why and when something appears. Action: a verb plus object.
- No results from a search gets a Clear filters action, not a Create action.

## Related

- [Skeleton](skeleton.md): Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads.
- [Alert](alert.md): A persistent inline message with a tone, icon and optional title that helps people recover or continue.
- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.

## Guidance for AI tools

Empty state: A centered placeholder with an optional icon for lists and views that have nothing to show yet. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# File browser

> Grid tiles and a sortable list or table of files and folders with type icons, selection and per-item context menus.

- Type: Component (data, Collections)
- Namespace: `ui.file-browser`
- Source: `src/ui/file_browser.cljc`
- Public fns: `file-type->icon`, `file-type-icon`, `file-view-toggle`, `file-item-grid`, `col-name`, `col-size`, `col-modified`, `col-type`, `file-table`, `file-list-header`, `file-item-list`
- Keywords: file browser, file manager, folder, grid view, list view, sortable columns

## When to use

- Browsing files, folders, media or any collection that switches between a tile grid and a detail list.
- Lists that need sortable columns and a right-click menu per row.

## When not to use

- Use table for plain records without a grid view.
- Use grid for image tiles without file semantics.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.file-browser :as fb])

[:div.fb-list
 (fb/file-list-header {:sort-key :name :sort-dir :asc :on-sort sort!})
 (for [item files]
   (fb/file-item-list {:item item :on-click open!
                       :context-menu-items [{:label "Open" :icon :folder}
                                            {:label "Delete" :icon :trash :variant :danger}]}))]
```

## Examples

### Grid tiles with a view toggle

```clojure
(fb/file-view-toggle {:view :grid :on-grid-click #(set-view! :grid) :on-list-click #(set-view! :list)})
[:div.fb-grid (for [item files] (fb/file-item-grid {:item item :selected (= item current)}))]
```

### Custom table columns

```clojure
(fb/file-table {:columns [fb/col-name fb/col-size {:key :owner :label "Owner" :width "120px"}]
                :items files :sort-key :name :sort-dir :asc :on-sort sort! :on-row-click open!})
```

## API reference

### `file-item-grid`

A file as a grid tile (icon, name, size).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:item` | `{:name :file-type :size}` | – |  |
| `:selected` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:on-click` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:context-menu-items` | `vector` | – | Wraps the tile in a context-menu-trigger. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `file-item-list`

A file as a list row (name, size, modified, type).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:item` | `{:name :file-type :size :modified}` | – |  |
| `:selected` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:on-click` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:context-menu-items` | `vector` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `file-list-header`

Column headers for the list view with sort indicators.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:sort-key` | `:name \| :size \| :modified \| :type` | – |  |
| `:sort-dir` | `:asc \| :desc` | – |  |
| `:on-sort` | `fn [col-key]` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `file-table`

Configurable CSS-grid table with sortable headers, row click, selection and per-row context menus.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `file-view-toggle`

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |

| `:size` | `icon size` | – |  |

### `file-type->icon`

Icon name for a file type.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab / Enter | Rows and tiles are buttons. |
| Shift+F10 | Opens the row's context menu. |

## Accessibility

- Sortable headers are buttons with the sort direction in text; type icons are decorative next to the name.

## Motion

- Row and tile hover tints over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- The list header and rows share a grid template; on phones prefer the grid view or hide secondary columns with :columns.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Render links in :attrs or :row-attrs-fn for navigation; context menus work through the runtime.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: All callbacks available.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant; file-type->icon returns strings.

## Notes for AI

- Sort in the host and pass the sorted :items; the component only renders indicators.

## Related

- [Table](table.md): Records in columns from a headers vector and row vectors, with striped and bordered variants.
- [Tile grid](grid.md): A responsive auto-fill grid of square or masonry tiles with size presets, plus a layout toggle and size stepper for toolbars.
- [Context menu](context-menu.md): Secondary actions close to the object: a right-click (or long-press on touch) menu for any wrapped element.
- [Drop zone](drop-zone.md): A generous target for dropping or picking files, with a full-page overlay variant and a click-to-add label.

## Guidance for AI tools

Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# File progress

> A bordered list of files with size, status and an optional progress bar and remove button.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.file-progress`
- Source: `src/ui/file_progress.cljc`
- Public fns: `file-progress-item`, `file-progress-list`
- Keywords: upload list, file progress, upload status, attachments

## When to use

- Showing each file's upload or processing state after a drop or pick.
- Attachment lists in a composer before sending.

## When not to use

- Use progress for a single overall bar.
- Use processing-bar for background jobs that are not files.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.file-progress :as fp])

(fp/file-progress-list {}
  (fp/file-progress-item {:name "photo.jpg" :size "2.4 MB" :progress 67 :status :uploading
                          :icon (icon/icon {:icon-name :image :size :sm}) :on-remove #(cancel! 1)})
  (fp/file-progress-item {:name "doc.pdf" :size "1.1 MB" :status :complete}))
```

## API reference

### `file-progress-list`

Continuous bordered list.

Children: file-progress-item elements.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `file-progress-item`

One file row.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:name` | `string` | – |  |
| `:size` | `string` | – | Formatted, e.g. 2.4 MB. |
| `:icon` | `hiccup` | – | Icon slot, e.g. from file-type-icon. |
| `:progress` | `0 to 100 \| nil` | – | nil hides the bar. |
| `:status` | `:idle \| :uploading \| :complete \| :error` | – |  |
| `:on-remove` | `fn []` | – | Shows a remove button when given. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

## Accessibility

- Status is a word plus an icon; the progress bar carries aria values. Remove buttons are labeled with the file name.

## Motion

- Progress width animates over --duration-standard.

## Responsive behavior

- Names truncate with the full value in the title attribute.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static; re-render on progress updates (HTMX polling works).
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Pass live :progress.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Errors say what to do: Too large, pick a file under 10 MB.

## Related

- [Drop zone](drop-zone.md): A generous target for dropping or picking files, with a full-page overlay variant and a click-to-add label.
- [Progress](progress.md): Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.
- [Processing bar](processing-bar.md): A compact accent-bordered panel listing background jobs in progress with thumbnails, labels and spinners.

## Guidance for AI tools

File progress: A bordered list of files with size, status and an optional progress bar and remove button. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Form

> Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar.

- Type: Component (inputs, Text fields)
- Namespace: `ui.form`
- Source: `src/ui/form.cljc`
- Public fns: `form-field-class-list`, `form-field-classes`, `form-field`, `form-input-class-list`, `form-input-classes`, `form-input`, `form-textarea-class-list`, `form-textarea-classes`, `form-textarea`, `form-textarea-auto`, `form-select`, `form-checkbox`, `form-radio-group`, `form-file`, `form-range`, `form-group`, `form-group-addon`, `search-bar`
- Keywords: input, textarea, form field, label, checkbox, radio, file input, range, search bar, validation

## When to use

- Any text, number, date or file entry; wrap each control in form-field for its label, hint and error.
- Inline validation: pass :error on both form-field and the input.
- A search entry with a joined button (search-bar) at the top of a list.

## When not to use

- Use switch for an on or off setting that applies immediately.
- Use select (or form-select) for one of many; use form-radio-group for two to five visible options.
- Use number-field for bounded numbers with steppers, tag-input for several values, color-picker for colors.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.form :as form])

(form/form-field {:label "Email" :hint "Used for sign-in and notifications." :error email-error}
  (form/form-input {:type :email :value email :error (some? email-error) :on-change set-email!}))
```

## Examples

### Search bar that submits as GET

```clojure
(form/search-bar {:action "/search" :placeholder "Search movies…" :button-label "Search"})
```

### Radio group

```clojure
(form/form-radio-group {:label "Preference" :radio-name "pref" :radio-value "a"
                        :options [{:value "a" :label "Option A"} {:value "b" :label "Option B"}]})
```

### Joined input and addon

```clojure
(form/form-group {}
  (form/form-group-addon {} "https://")
  (form/form-input {:placeholder "example.com"}))
```

## API reference

### `form-field`

Wrapper with label above, hint or error below. The error text also sets the error state.

Children: The control.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:label` | `string` | – |  |
| `:hint` | `string` | – |  |
| `:error` | `string` | – | Error message; shown in place of the hint. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `form-input`

Single-line input. With :icon-left or :icon-right it is wrapped in .form-input-wrap.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:type` | `keyword` | `:text` | :text, :email, :password, :date, :datetime-local, ... |
| `:placeholder` | `string` | – |  |
| `:value` | `string` | – |  |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:error` | `boolean` | – | Error styling. |
| `:icon-left` | `icon keyword` | – |  |
| `:icon-right` | `icon keyword` | – |  |
| `:on-change` | `fn` | – | :cljs and :squint only. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | name, required, autocomplete, pattern and so on. |

### `form-textarea`

Multi-line input.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:placeholder` | `string` | – |  |
| `:value` | `string` | – |  |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:error` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:on-change` | `fn` | – |  |

### `form-checkbox`

Joins inputs, addons and buttons into one bordered row with shared corners.

Preset: icon input joined to a primary button; wrapped in a GET <form> when :action or :on-submit is set.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:name` | `string` | `"q"` |  |

| `:icon` | `icon keyword` | `:search` |  |
| `:button-label` | `string` | `"Search"` |  |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:action` | `string` | – | Form action URL. |
| `:on-change` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-submit` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |
| `:form-attrs` | `map` | – | Attributes on the wrapping <form>. |

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves between fields. |
| Space | Toggles a checkbox or radio. |
| Arrow keys | Move within a radio group or a range. |

## Accessibility

- form-field renders a real <label>; pass an id via :attrs on the control and the label picks it up through nesting.
- Errors sit next to the field and say how to fix it; do not rely on the red border alone.
- Inputs are 44px tall by default, the phone tap minimum.

## Motion

- Border and background transitions over --duration-fast. Focus shows the shared ring.

## Responsive behavior

- Fields fill their column; forms read best at 640 to 720px wide. form-group stays on one line and scrolls its content.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Uncontrolled inputs that submit with a <form>; use :attrs for name and required.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Controlled via :value and :on-change (receives the DOM event).
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Controlled; never pass false to :disabled or :required (use (when x true)).

## Notes for AI

- One form-field per control; the label is the only heading a field needs.
- Use search-bar for the search pattern instead of assembling form-group by hand; the joined corners are easy to get wrong.
- Submit buttons are verb plus object: Save changes, Create project.

## Related

- [Select](select.md): A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support.
- [Switch](switch.md): A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.
- [Number field](number-field.md): A bounded numeric input with increment and decrement steppers and scroll-wheel support.
- [Tag input](tag-input.md): Turns short text into removable tags with a filtered suggestion dropdown; fully controlled by the host.
- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.

## Guidance for AI tools

Form: Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Tile grid

> A responsive auto-fill grid of square or masonry tiles with size presets, plus a layout toggle and size stepper for toolbars.

- Type: Component (layout, Layout)
- Namespace: `ui.grid`
- Source: `src/ui/grid.cljc`
- Public fns: `grid-class-list`, `grid-classes`, `grid`, `layout-toggle`, `step-size`, `size-stepper`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.masonry` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: grid, masonry, tiles, photo grid, gallery, tile size

## When to use

- Photo and media galleries, cards of equal weight, any tile collection that should reflow by width.
- Letting people pick tile size and layout from a toolbar.

## When not to use

- Use file-browser for files with names, sizes and list views.
- Use the layout.css 12-column helpers for page layout, not for collections.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.grid :as grid])

(grid/grid {:layout :masonry :size :m}
  (for [img images] (lightbox/image-thumbnail {:src (:src img)})))
```

## Examples

### Toolbar controls

```clojure
(grid/layout-toggle {:value layout :on-change set-layout! :boxed true})
(grid/size-stepper {:value size :on-change set-size!})
```

### Server-rendered toggle with links

```clojure
(grid/layout-toggle {:value "grid" :options [{:value "grid" :icon :grid :label "Grid" :href "/?view=grid"}
                                            {:value "masonry" :icon :layers :label "Masonry" :href "/?view=masonry"}]})
```

## API reference

### `grid`

The grid container. Masonry uses the runtime where the browser lacks native masonry rows.

Children: Tiles.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:layout` | `:grid \| :masonry` | `:grid` |  |
| `:size` | `:s \| :m \| :l \| :xl \| :xxl` | `:m` | Tile minimum width preset. |
| `:min` | `CSS length` | – | Explicit tile min width; wins over :size. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `layout-toggle`

Segmented icon toggle between layouts.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:value` | `keyword \| string` | – |  |
| `:options` | `vector of {:value :icon :label :href}` | `grid and masonry` |  |
| `:on-change` | `fn [value]` | – |  |
| `:boxed` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `size-stepper`

Minus and plus stepper over the size presets, disabled at the ends.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:value` | `keyword \| string` | – |  |
| `:sizes` | `vector` | `ui.grid/sizes` |  |
| `:on-change` | `fn [size]` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `step-size`

Pure: next size along a vector, clamped.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through the toggle and stepper buttons. |

## Accessibility

- Toggle options have labels; the stepper buttons are labeled and disabled at the ends.

## Motion

- None on the grid; masonry re-layout happens on resize without animation.

## Responsive behavior

- Auto-fill reflows by width; pick :s on phones through the stepper.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Give toggle options :href; the masonry runtime self-initializes.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Use :on-change on both controls.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Tiles decide their own aspect ratio; the grid only sets columns.

## Related

- [Lightbox](lightbox.md): A fullscreen image overlay with pinch, wheel and double-tap zoom and drag to pan, plus a clickable thumbnail.
- [File browser](file-browser.md): Grid tiles and a sortable list or table of files and folders with type icons, selection and per-item context menus.
- [Button group](button-group.md): Related actions as one segmented control: ghost or boxed, with icon items, counts and separators.

## Guidance for AI tools

Tile grid: A responsive auto-fill grid of square or masonry tiles with size presets, plus a layout toggle and size stepper for toolbars. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Icon

> Inline Lucide-style SVG icons in four sizes, outlined by default with filled variants for media controls.

- Type: Component (data, Primitives)
- Namespace: `ui.icon`
- Source: `src/ui/icon.cljc`
- Public fns: `icon-class-list`, `icon-classes`, `icon`
- Keywords: icon, svg, lucide, filled icon, icon size

## When to use

- A plain icon beside its label in buttons, menus, nav items and empty states.
- Icon-only controls with an aria-label.

## When not to use

- Do not put icons in rounded tiles or circles unless the shape is the control itself.
- Use a text label when it is clearer than an icon, especially for destructive or unfamiliar actions.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.icon :as icon])

(icon/icon {:icon-name :search :size :sm})
(icon/icon {:icon-name :play :filled true})
```

## API reference

### `icon`

Returns an inline <svg> with currentColor strokes, or nil for an unknown name. See docs/components.md for the full icon list.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:icon-name` | `keyword` | – | One of the registered names, e.g. :home, :search, :settings. |
| `:size` | `:sm \| :md \| :lg \| :xl` | `:md` | 16, 20, 24 or 32px. |
| `:filled` | `boolean` | – | Solid variant; falls back to the outline paths with fill when no dedicated filled shape exists. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | Extra SVG attributes. |

### `icon-classes`

Class string for {:size}.

### `icon-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Icons are aria-hidden by default; the control they sit in carries the name.

## Motion

- None.

## Responsive behavior

- Sizes are fixed; use :sm inside small buttons and :md in nav.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Static markup.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Icon names are strings at runtime.

## Notes for AI

- Add new icons to icon-paths in src/ui/icon.cljc (Lucide 24x24 paths), then run bb gen-docs.
- Pick :sm for 16px toolbars, :md for menus, :xl only in empty states.

## Related

- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.
- [Empty state](empty-state.md): A centered placeholder with an optional icon for lists and views that have nothing to show yet.
- [Badge](badge.md): A small pill for status, category or a count, with an optional leading icon.

## Guidance for AI tools

Icon: Inline Lucide-style SVG icons in four sizes, outlined by default with filled variants for media controls. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Lightbox

> A fullscreen image overlay with pinch, wheel and double-tap zoom and drag to pan, plus a clickable thumbnail.

- Type: Component (media, Media)
- Namespace: `ui.lightbox`
- Source: `src/ui/lightbox.cljc`
- Public fns: `lightbox`, `image-thumbnail`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.lightbox` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: lightbox, image viewer, zoom, fullscreen image, gallery

## When to use

- Viewing one image large from a grid or a message.

## When not to use

- Use dialog for content that is not a single image.
- Use grid plus thumbnails for the collection itself.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.lightbox :as lightbox])

(lightbox/image-thumbnail {:src thumb :on-click #(open! full})
(lightbox/lightbox {:src (:open-image state) :on-close close!})
```

## API reference

### `lightbox`

Renders the overlay only while :src is set. Clicking the backdrop or the close button calls :on-close.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:src` | `string \| nil` | – |  |
| `:alt` | `string` | `"image"` |  |
| `:on-close` | `fn` | – |  |

### `image-thumbnail`

A clickable image.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:src` | `string` | – |  |
| `:alt` | `string` | – |  |
| `:on-click` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string \| vector` | – |  |

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Closes (wire in the host for the overlay variant). |

## Accessibility

- The image keeps its alt text; the close button is labeled.

## Motion

- The overlay fades in over --duration-fast; zoom follows the gesture directly and snaps back into bounds on release.

## Responsive behavior

- Two-finger pinch and one-finger pan on touch; the page-level pinch block stays in place.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Render the overlay from a query parameter or open it with inline JS.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Controlled by state via :src and :on-close.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant; require ui.js.lightbox in the SPA.

## Notes for AI

- Do not hand-roll zoom; the runtime owns it and resets on image load.

## Related

- [Tile grid](grid.md): A responsive auto-fill grid of square or masonry tiles with size presets, plus a layout toggle and size stepper for toolbars.
- [Dialog](dialog.md): A focused modal surface for decisions that need attention, as a native <dialog> or an overlay for reactive apps.
- [Camera](camera.md): A viewfinder with capture and camera switch, falling back to the native file input capture on plain HTTP, plus stream helpers.

## Guidance for AI tools

Lightbox: A fullscreen image overlay with pinch, wheel and double-tap zoom and drag to pan, plus a clickable thumbnail. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Markdown

> A minimal markdown to hiccup renderer for docs and chat replies: headings, code blocks, tables, lists, inline code and bold.

- Type: Component (text, Text)
- Namespace: `ui.markdown`
- Source: `src/ui/markdown.cljc`
- Public fns: `markdown->hiccup`
- Keywords: markdown, render, hiccup, docs, code block

## When to use

- Rendering documentation, help text or assistant replies written in simple markdown.

## When not to use

- Use a full parser for nested lists, links in tables, footnotes or HTML passthrough.
- Escape untrusted input yourself before rendering.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.markdown :as markdown])

(into [:div.md] (markdown/markdown->hiccup "# Title\n\nSome **bold** text with `code`."))
```

## API reference

### `markdown->hiccup`

Converts a markdown string to a vector of hiccup elements with md- classes.

## Accessibility

- Produces semantic headings, lists, tables and pre blocks.

## Motion

- None.

## Responsive behavior

- Code blocks scroll horizontally; tables are plain and may need a wrapper on phones.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Pure function.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Pure function.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Pure function.

## Notes for AI

- Pass the output as children of a chat-bubble or a card body.

## Related

- [Chat](chat.md): Conversation building blocks: a message log, user and assistant bubbles, a thinking indicator, a toolbar and an auto-growing composer.
- [Card](card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content and actions, plus a divided list variant.

## Guidance for AI tools

Markdown: A minimal markdown to hiccup renderer for docs and chat replies: headings, code blocks, tables, lists, inline code and bold. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Number field

> A bounded numeric input with increment and decrement steppers and scroll-wheel support.

- Type: Component (inputs, Text fields)
- Namespace: `ui.number-field`
- Source: `src/ui/number_field.cljc`
- Public fns: `normalize-variant`, `clamp-value`, `step-value`, `number-field-class-list`, `number-field-classes`, `number-field`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.number-field` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: number input, stepper, numeric field, spinner, quantity

## When to use

- Bounded numbers that people nudge: quantity, hours, font size, zoom.
- Values with a natural step where keyboard entry should still work.

## When not to use

- Use form-input :type :text with a pattern for ids, codes and phone numbers.
- Use form-range when the exact number matters less than the position.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.number-field :as number-field])

(number-field/number-field {:value 2 :min 1 :max 10 :step 1
                            :on-change #(set-qty! (.. % -target -value))})
```

## Examples

### Variants

```clojure
(number-field/number-field {:value 16 :variant :right :size :sm})
(number-field/number-field {:value 1.5 :step 0.5 :variant :spinner})
```

## API reference

### `number-field`

Wrapper with an <input type=number> and stepper buttons. The number-field runtime clamps steppers and wheel changes and fires a native input event.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:value` | `number` | – | Current value. |
| `:min` | `number` | – |  |
| `:max` | `number` | – |  |
| `:step` | `number` | `1` |  |
| `:size` | `:sm \| :md \| :lg` | `:md` |  |
| `:variant` | `:default \| :right \| :spinner` | `:default` | Steppers flanking the input, both on the right, or a detached up and down box. |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:placeholder` | `string` | – |  |
| `:name` | `string` | – | Forwarded to the input. |
| `:id` | `string` | – | Forwarded to the input. |
| `:on-change` | `fn [event]` | – | :cljs and :squint; fires for typing, steppers and wheel. |
| `:class` | `string` | – | On the wrapper. |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | On the wrapper. |
| `:input-attrs` | `map` | – | On the <input>. |

### `clamp-value`

Clamps a number into [min max].

### `step-value`

Steps a value by {:step :min :max} in a direction.

### `number-field-classes`

Class string for {:size :variant :disabled}.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Step by :step (native). |
| Scroll wheel over the field | Steps the value (runtime). |

## Accessibility

- Native number input; steppers have aria-labels. Pair with form-field for a visible label.

## Motion

- Stepper hover tint over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- Height follows :size; steppers are at least 36px targets.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Uncontrolled: submit the input with a form. Needs ui-runtime.js for the steppers.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Pass :value and :on-change; read the value from the event target.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant; require ui.js.number-field in the SPA.

## Notes for AI

- Wrap in form-field for the label; do not add a second stepper UI.

## Related

- [Form](form.md): Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar.
- [Select](select.md): A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support.

## Guidance for AI tools

Number field: A bounded numeric input with increment and decrement steppers and scroll-wheel support. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Pagination

> Move through a long collection with numbered pages and previous and next links.

- Type: Component (data, Collections)
- Namespace: `ui.pagination`
- Source: `src/ui/pagination.cljc`
- Public fns: `pagination-item-class-list`, `pagination-item-classes`, `pagination`
- Keywords: pagination, pages, next previous, paging

## When to use

- Collections split into pages on the server, where each page has a URL.
- Tables and lists with a known total page count.

## When not to use

- Use infinite scroll or a Load more button for feeds without a meaningful page number.
- Use tabs or button-group to switch between views, not pages.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.pagination :as pagination])

(pagination/pagination {:current 3 :total 10
                        :href-fn #(str "/items?page=" %)})
```

## Examples

### Client-side paging

```clojure
(pagination/pagination {:current page :total 10 :on-click set-page!})
```

## API reference

### `pagination`

Renders <nav aria-label=Pagination> with Previous, every page number and Next.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:current` | `int` | – | Current page, 1-based. |
| `:total` | `int` | – | Total number of pages. |
| `:href-fn` | `fn [page] -> url` | – | Builds each page link (hiccup). |
| `:on-click` | `fn [page]` | – | Click handler on :cljs and :squint; prevents the default navigation. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `pagination-item-classes`

Class string for {:active :disabled}.

### `pagination-item-class-list`

Vector form.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through the page links. |
| Enter | Follows the link. |

## Accessibility

- Links inside a labeled nav; the active page is marked by its class and should also carry aria-current via :attrs when needed.
- Disabled Previous and Next keep their href but are styled inert.

## Motion

- Hover tint over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- Every page number renders; for more than about ten pages show a window of pages in the app before passing :total.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Use :href-fn; each page is a real link.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Use :on-click for client-side paging; :href-fn is optional.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Numbers use tabular-nums; keep Previous and Next as words, not arrows alone.

## Related

- [Table](table.md): Records in columns from a headers vector and row vectors, with striped and bordered variants.
- [Breadcrumb](breadcrumb.md): Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy; every item but the last is a link.
- [Button group](button-group.md): Related actions as one segmented control: ghost or boxed, with icon items, counts and separators.

## Guidance for AI tools

Pagination: Move through a long collection with numbered pages and previous and next links. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Resizable panels

> Panel groups whose panes trade space by dragging a separator, with collapse, keyboard resizing and persisted sizes.

- Type: Component (layout, Layout)
- Namespace: `ui.panels`
- Source: `src/ui/panels.cljc`
- Public fns: `size-str`, `group-attrs`, `panel-attrs`, `group`, `separator`, `panel`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.panels` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: resizable panels, split view, sidebar resize, drag separator, collapsible pane

## When to use

- Two or more panes that trade space: a sidebar beside content, an editor beside a preview.
- Layouts whose pane sizes should persist per user (:persist-key).

## When not to use

- Use sidebar-layout for a fixed-width app sidebar.
- Use dialog or popover for temporary surfaces.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.panels :as panels])

(panels/group {:orientation :horizontal}
  (panels/panel {:size 240 :min-size 160 :max-size 420 :collapsible true :persist-key "sidebar"}
    sidebar-content)
  (panels/separator {:label "Resize sidebar"})
  (panels/panel {:pin true} main-content))
```

## API reference

### `group`

Flex container for panels.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:orientation` | `:horizontal \| :vertical` | `:horizontal` |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `panel`

A pane. With :size it is resizable; without, it fills the rest.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:size` | `px number \| "NN%"` | – |  |
| `:min-size` | `px` | – |  |
| `:max-size` | `px` | – |  |
| `:default-size` | `px` | – |  |
| `:collapsible` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:collapsed` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:persist-key` | `string` | – | localStorage key for size and collapsed state. |
| `:pin` | `boolean` | – | On the fill panel: keep content anchored while a sized panel collapses. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `separator`

Draggable, keyboard-operable seam between two panels.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:label` | `string` | – | aria-label. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `panel-attrs`

Data attributes for a sized panel, for custom markup.

### `group-attrs`

Data attributes for a group.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Arrow keys on the separator | Resize in steps. |
| Enter on the separator | Toggle collapse when collapsible. |

## Accessibility

- The separator has role=separator with an aria-label and aria-valuenow.

## Motion

- Collapse and programmatic size changes animate over --duration-standard; dragging tracks the pointer.

## Responsive behavior

- Percent sizes scale with the group; set :min-size so panes stay usable on phones, or stack vertically.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Markup plus ui-runtime.js; sizes persist in the browser.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Listen for ui-panels-resize and ui-panels-collapse CustomEvents via :attrs, or drive data-size and data-collapsed.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant; require ui.js.panels in the SPA.

## Notes for AI

- Exactly one fill panel per group; give every sized panel a :min-size.

## Related

- [Sidebar](sidebar.md): An app shell: a sticky sidebar with brand, search, grouped menus, collapsible sections, user footer and a mobile drawer, next to the main area.
- [Separator](separator.md): A hairline divider, horizontal or vertical, for grouping content.

## Guidance for AI tools

Resizable panels: Panel groups whose panes trade space by dragging a separator, with collapse, keyboard resizing and persisted sizes. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Player bar

> A music player bar with artwork, track info, transport controls, a scrubbable progress track and volume.

- Type: Component (media, Media)
- Namespace: `ui.player-bar`
- Source: `src/ui/player_bar.cljc`
- Public fns: `player-bar-class-list`, `player-bar-classes`, `player-bar`
- Keywords: player, audio player, transport controls, now playing, scrubber

## When to use

- A persistent playback bar at the bottom of a music or podcast app.

## When not to use

- Use timeline for editing media with segments.
- Use progress for a plain non-interactive bar.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.player-bar :as player-bar])

(player-bar/player-bar {:track-name "Across the Universe" :subtitle "The Beatles"
                        :playing true :progress 36 :current-time "1:23" :duration "3:48"
                        :on-play-pause toggle! :on-next next! :on-previous prev!
                        :on-seek seek-from-event!})
```

## API reference

### `player-bar`

The full bar. All state comes from props; every control reports through a callback.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:track-name` | `string` | – |  |
| `:subtitle` | `string` | – |  |
| `:artwork` | `hiccup` | – |  |
| `:playing` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:progress` | `0 to 100` | – |  |
| `:current-time` | `string` | – |  |
| `:duration` | `string` | – |  |
| `:shuffle` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:repeat` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:favorited` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:on-play-pause` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-next` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-previous` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-shuffle` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-repeat` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-favorite` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:on-seek` | `fn [pointer-event]` | – | Fires on tap and while dragging the track; compute the position from clientX and the target rect. |
| `:on-volume` | `fn` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `player-bar-classes`

Class string for the container.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Tab | Moves through the transport buttons. |
| Space on play | Toggles playback. |

## Accessibility

- Every control is a labeled icon button; times use tabular numerals.

## Motion

- The scrubber thumb appears on hover (always on touch) over --duration-fast; press feedback on buttons.

## Responsive behavior

- Secondary controls hide below the small breakpoint; the track stays scrubbable by touch.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static bar; wire controls with :attrs or HTMX.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: All callbacks; :on-seek receives the pointer event.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Keep the bar outside scrolling containers so it stays fixed at the bottom.

## Related

- [Editing timeline](timeline.md): A media editing timeline: a scrubbable ruler, labeled tracks with draggable and trimmable segments, a playhead and a floating transport.
- [Progress](progress.md): Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.
- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.

## Guidance for AI tools

Player bar: A music player bar with artwork, track info, transport controls, a scrubbable progress track and volume. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Popover

> A small anchored panel for contextual controls, built on the native Popover API so it works without app state.

- Type: Component (disclosure, Overlays)
- Namespace: `ui.popover`
- Source: `src/ui/popover.cljc`
- Public fns: `trigger-attrs`, `content-class-list`, `popover-trigger`, `popover-content`, `popover-header`, `popover-title`, `popover-description`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.popover` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: popover, anchored panel, popovertarget, dropdown panel, settings panel

## When to use

- Small anchored controls (a couple of fields, a picker) that should not dim the page.
- Contextual information next to its trigger.

## When not to use

- Use dialog for a decision that must interrupt.
- Use context-menu for a list of actions on right-click or long press.
- Use tooltip for one line of hint text.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.popover :as popover])

(popover/popover-trigger {:target "dimensions"
                          :class (button/button-classes {:variant :secondary})}
  "Open")
(popover/popover-content {:id "dimensions" :side :bottom :align :start}
  (popover/popover-header {}
    (popover/popover-title {} "Dimensions")
    (popover/popover-description {} "Set the dimensions for the layer."))
  (form/form-field {:label "Width"} (form/form-input {:value "100%"})))
```

## Examples

### Turn an existing button into a trigger

```clojure
(button/button {:variant :ghost :icon :settings
                :attrs (merge {:aria-label "Settings"} (popover/trigger-attrs "settings"))})
```

## API reference

### `popover-trigger`

A <button> with popovertarget pointing at the content's id.

Children: The trigger label.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:target` | `string` | – | Id of the matching popover-content (required). |
| `:class` | `string` | – | Usually a button class string. |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `popover-content`

The floating panel (popover="auto"). The JS runtime anchors it to the trigger.

Children: popover-header and any content.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:id` | `string` | – | Must match the trigger's :target (required). |
| `:side` | `:top \| :right \| :bottom \| :left` | `:bottom` | Which side of the trigger the panel opens on. |
| `:align` | `:start \| :center \| :end` | `:center` | Alignment along that side. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `popover-header`

Title block.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `popover-title`

Heading text.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `popover-description`

Muted description.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `trigger-attrs`

Attribute map {:popovertarget id :aria-haspopup "dialog"} to spread onto any element.

### `content-class-list`

Class vector for {:side}.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Escape | Closes the popover (native). |
| Enter / Space | On the trigger, toggles it. |

## Accessibility

- The trigger carries aria-haspopup=dialog; the native Popover API manages light dismiss and Escape.
- Give the panel a title so it has an accessible name.

## Motion

- The panel fades and nudges in from its side over --duration-fast; reduced motion fades only.

## Responsive behavior

- Max width is 20rem or the viewport minus a margin; the runtime flips sides when there is no room.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Works in server-rendered pages: load ui-runtime.js once.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Same markup; no state needed. Replicant keeps the popover attribute.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same markup; ids must be stable across re-renders.

## Notes for AI

- The trigger :target and the content :id must match and be unique on the page.
- Keep the content to a few controls; a long form belongs in a dialog or a page.

## Related

- [Dialog](dialog.md): A focused modal surface for decisions that need attention, as a native <dialog> or an overlay for reactive apps.
- [Context menu](context-menu.md): Secondary actions close to the object: a right-click (or long-press on touch) menu for any wrapped element.
- [Tooltip](tooltip.md): Short supporting text for an unfamiliar control, shown on hover and focus with pure CSS.
- [Select](select.md): A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support.

## Guidance for AI tools

Popover: A small anchored panel for contextual controls, built on the native Popover API so it works without app state. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Processing bar

> A compact accent-bordered panel listing background jobs in progress with thumbnails, labels and spinners.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.processing-bar`
- Source: `src/ui/processing_bar.cljc`
- Public fns: `processing-item`, `processing-bar`
- Keywords: background jobs, processing, in progress, queue status

## When to use

- Several background jobs running at once (scans, imports, conversions) that people should see without blocking.

## When not to use

- Use toast for the result of one finished job.
- Use file-progress for per-file upload progress.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.processing-bar :as processing-bar])

(when (seq jobs)
  (processing-bar/processing-bar {:title "2 scans in progress"}
    (for [j jobs]
      (processing-bar/processing-item {:thumb (:thumb j) :label (:label j) :status (:status j)}))))
```

## API reference

### `processing-bar`

The panel; renders unconditionally, the host decides visibility.

Children: processing-item elements.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:title` | `string` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `processing-item`

One job row with spinner and status.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:thumb` | `image URL` | – |  |
| `:label` | `string` | – | Secondary line above the status. |
| `:status` | `string \| hiccup` | – |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

## Accessibility

- Mark the panel as a polite live region in :attrs when jobs change often.

## Motion

- The panel slides in over --duration-standard with --ease-enter.

## Responsive behavior

- Full width of its column; thumbnails are 32px.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Re-render with HTMX polling.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Render from state.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Status text is a present participle: Analyzing, Resizing.

## Related

- [File progress](file-progress.md): A bordered list of files with size, status and an optional progress bar and remove button.
- [Toast](toast.md): A brief floating confirmation for completed background work, shown by the JS runtime on every target.
- [Spinner](spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color.

## Guidance for AI tools

Processing bar: A compact accent-bordered panel listing background jobs in progress with thumbnails, labels and spinners. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Progress

> Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.progress`
- Source: `src/ui/progress.cljc`
- Public fns: `progress-bar-class-list`, `progress-bar-classes`, `progress`
- Keywords: progress bar, percentage, upload progress, determinate

## When to use

- Known progress: an upload, an import, steps completed out of a total.
- Usage against a limit when paired with a label.

## When not to use

- Use spinner for unknown duration.
- Use skeleton while content is loading in place.
- Use file-progress for a list of files each with their own status.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.progress :as progress])

(progress/progress {:value 62 :attrs {:aria-label "Upload progress"}})
```

## Examples

### Tones

```clojure
(progress/progress {:value 90 :variant :warning})
(progress/progress {:value 100 :variant :success})
```

## API reference

### `progress`

A track with a fill at :value percent; role=progressbar with aria-valuenow.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:value` | `number 0 to 100` | `0` |  |
| `:variant` | `nil \| :success \| :warning \| :danger` | – | Fill tone; default is the accent. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | Add aria-label or aria-labelledby. |

### `progress-bar-classes`

Class string for the fill given {:variant}.

### `progress-bar-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Exposes value, min and max; give it a name with aria-label.
- Show the percentage or count as text next to it when the number matters.

## Motion

- The fill width animates over --duration-standard.

## Responsive behavior

- Fills its column.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static; re-render to update.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Pass the live :value.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Pass the live :value; style uses string keys internally.

## Notes for AI

- Status tones only for real status: warning near a limit, danger when failed.

## Related

- [Spinner](spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color.
- [Skeleton](skeleton.md): Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads.
- [File progress](file-progress.md): A bordered list of files with size, status and an optional progress bar and remove button.
- [Processing bar](processing-bar.md): A compact accent-bordered panel listing background jobs in progress with thumbnails, labels and spinners.

## Guidance for AI tools

Progress: Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Select

> A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support.

- Type: Component (inputs, Selection)
- Namespace: `ui.select`
- Source: `src/ui/select.cljc`
- Public fns: `normalize-options`, `selected-label`, `select`
- JS runtime: `ui.js.select` (bundled in ui-runtime.js)
- Keywords: select, dropdown, listbox, combobox, choice field

## When to use

- One of many options (more than about five) in a form or a toolbar.
- A choice that must look the same in every browser and both themes.

## When not to use

- Use form-radio-group for two to five visible options.
- Use command for a searchable list of actions or a long list that needs filtering.
- Use button-group to switch between views.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.select :as select])

(select/select {:options [{:value "eu" :label "Europe"}
                          {:value "us" :label "United States"}]
                :value region
                :placeholder "Pick a region"
                :on-change set-region!})
```

## Examples

### Hiccup form field (uncontrolled, submits with the form)

```clojure
(select/select {:name "region" :options ["Europe" "United States"] :value "Europe"})
```

## API reference

### `select`

Renders the trigger button; the listbox is created by the __uiSelect runtime on open.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:options` | `vector of {:value :label} or strings` | – | The choices. Bare strings use the string as value and label. |
| `:value` | `string` | – | Selected value. |
| `:placeholder` | `string` | – | Shown when nothing is selected. |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – |  |
| `:on-change` | `fn [value]` | – | Receives the picked value (:cljs and :squint). |
| `:name` | `string` | – | On :clj emits a hidden <input> so the value submits with a form. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `normalize-options`

Coerces strings into {:value :label} maps.

### `selected-label`

Label for the selected value, else the placeholder.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Enter / Space / ArrowDown | Opens the listbox. |
| ArrowUp / ArrowDown | Moves the highlighted option. |
| Enter | Picks the highlighted option. |
| Escape | Closes without changing. |

## Accessibility

- The trigger has role=combobox with aria-haspopup=listbox and aria-expanded.
- Options are focusable rows; the selected one is marked.

## Motion

- The listbox fades and scales in over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- The listbox is capped to the viewport and scrolls; on touch the outside tap that dismisses it is consumed.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Uncontrolled; pass :name for form submission. Needs ui-runtime.js.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Controlled through :value and :on-change.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Controlled; the trigger re-renders with the new label.

## Notes for AI

- form-select in ui.form delegates here; use it inside form-field for a label and hint.
- Keep option labels short; put the long explanation in a hint.

## Related

- [Form](form.md): Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar.
- [Command palette](command.md): A searchable command menu in a native dialog with groups, icons, shortcut hints, a global hotkey and Alt quick-select.
- [Popover](popover.md): A small anchored panel for contextual controls, built on the native Popover API so it works without app state.
- [Tag input](tag-input.md): Turns short text into removable tags with a filtered suggestion dropdown; fully controlled by the host.

## Guidance for AI tools

Select: A compact choice field with a framework-drawn listbox, keyboard navigation and form support. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Separator

> A hairline divider, horizontal or vertical, for grouping content.

- Type: Component (layout, Layout)
- Namespace: `ui.separator`
- Source: `src/ui/separator.cljc`
- Public fns: `separator-class-list`, `separator-classes`, `separator`
- Keywords: separator, divider, hr, rule

## When to use

- Dividing groups inside a surface where spacing alone is not enough (menus, sidebars, toolbars).

## When not to use

- Prefer spacing first; a border second; a separator only where the two cannot do the job.
- Inside toolbar or button-group use their own separator components.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.separator :as separator])

(separator/separator {})
(separator/separator {:orientation :vertical :class "mx-2"})
```

## API reference

### `separator`

A <div role=none> line.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:orientation` | `:horizontal \| :vertical` | `:horizontal` |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `separator-classes`

Class string for {:orientation}.

### `separator-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Decorative (role=none). Use a heading, not a separator, to announce a new section.

## Motion

- None.

## Responsive behavior

- A vertical separator needs a flex row with a defined height.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Uses border-subtle; never draw your own 1px lines.

## Related

- [Toolbar](toolbar.md): A pill-shaped container that groups icon buttons with separators, horizontal or vertical, optionally floating in a popover.
- [Button group](button-group.md): Related actions as one segmented control: ghost or boxed, with icon items, counts and separators.
- [Sidebar](sidebar.md): An app shell: a sticky sidebar with brand, search, grouped menus, collapsible sections, user footer and a mobile drawer, next to the main area.

## Guidance for AI tools

Separator: A hairline divider, horizontal or vertical, for grouping content. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Sidebar

> An app shell: a sticky sidebar with brand, search, grouped menus, collapsible sections, user footer and a mobile drawer, next to the main area.

- Type: Component (layout, App shell)
- Namespace: `ui.sidebar`
- Source: `src/ui/sidebar.cljc`
- Public fns: `sidebar-layout-class-list`, `sidebar-layout-classes`, `sidebar-layout`, `sidebar-layout-main`, `sidebar-class-list`, `sidebar-classes`, `sidebar`, `sidebar-header`, `sidebar-brand-class-list`, `sidebar-brand-classes`, `sidebar-brand`, `sidebar-search-class-list`, `sidebar-search-classes`, `sidebar-search`, `sidebar-content`, `sidebar-group-class-list`, `sidebar-group-classes`, `sidebar-group`, `sidebar-menu`, `sidebar-menu-item-class-list`, `sidebar-menu-item-classes`, `sidebar-menu-item`, `sidebar-collapsible`, `sidebar-mobile-toggle-class-list`, `sidebar-mobile-toggle-classes`, `sidebar-mobile-toggle`, `sidebar-overlay`, `sidebar-separator`, `sidebar-footer`, `sidebar-user`
- Keywords: sidebar, app shell, navigation, layout, mobile drawer, nav menu

## When to use

- App-level navigation between sections, with groups and an account block.
- Any page that needs the sidebar plus main layout with a mobile toggle.

## When not to use

- Use tabs or breadcrumb for navigation inside one page.
- Use panels when the sidebar must be resizable.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.sidebar :as sidebar])

(sidebar/sidebar-layout {}
  (sidebar/sidebar {}
    (sidebar/sidebar-header {} (sidebar/sidebar-brand {:title "Acme" :subtitle "v1.0" :icon "A"}))
    (sidebar/sidebar-content {}
      (sidebar/sidebar-group {:label "Pages"}
        (sidebar/sidebar-menu {}
          (sidebar/sidebar-menu-item {:href "/" :icon-name :home :active true} "Home")
          (sidebar/sidebar-menu-item {:href "/settings" :icon-name :settings :badge "2"} "Settings"))))
    (sidebar/sidebar-footer {} (sidebar/sidebar-user {:user-name "Ada" :email "ada@example.com" :avatar "AL"})))
  (sidebar/sidebar-overlay {})
  (sidebar/sidebar-layout-main {}
    (sidebar/sidebar-mobile-toggle {})
    page-content))
```

## API reference

### `sidebar-layout`

Flex row wrapping the sidebar, overlay and main area.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `sidebar-layout-main`

Main content area.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `sidebar`

The sticky sidebar container (bg-0, right border).

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `sidebar-header`

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |

## Accessibility

- Menu items are links or buttons; mark the current one with aria-current via :attrs. Group labels are plain headings.

## Motion

- The mobile drawer slides in over --duration-standard; item hover tints over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- Below the breakpoint the sidebar becomes an off-canvas drawer with the overlay; the toggle sits in the main area.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Works without JS for navigation; the mobile toggle uses a tiny inline handler in the runtime.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Pass :on-click on items for client-side routing.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Same as Replicant.

## Notes for AI

- Group labels are sentence case; keep groups to five or six items.
- Spend the accent on the active item only.

## Related

- [Breadcrumb](breadcrumb.md): Shows where a page sits in a hierarchy; every item but the last is a link.
- [Theme toggle](theme-toggle.md): A three-way segmented control for light, system and dark appearance, hydrated by the JS runtime.
- [Command palette](command.md): A searchable command menu in a native dialog with groups, icons, shortcut hints, a global hotkey and Alt quick-select.

## Guidance for AI tools

Sidebar: An app shell: a sticky sidebar with brand, search, grouped menus, collapsible sections, user footer and a mobile drawer, next to the main area. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

# Skeleton

> Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.skeleton`
- Source: `src/ui/skeleton.cljc`
- Public fns: `skeleton-class-list`, `skeleton-classes`, `skeleton`
- Keywords: skeleton, loading placeholder, shimmer, lazy loading

## When to use

- Loading a region whose final layout is known: a card, a list, an avatar and name.
- First paint of data-driven views so nothing jumps when the data arrives.

## When not to use

- Use spinner for a short action with no layout to reserve, such as a button.
- Use progress when the completion is known.
- Use empty-state when loading finished and there is nothing to show.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.skeleton :as skeleton])

[:div.vstack
 (skeleton/skeleton {:variant :heading})
 (skeleton/skeleton {:variant :line})
 (skeleton/skeleton {:variant :line :class "w-full"})]
```

## Examples

### Avatar row

```clojure
[:div.hstack
 (skeleton/skeleton {:variant :circle})
 (skeleton/skeleton {:variant :line})]
```

## API reference

### `skeleton`

A pulsing block with role=status and an accessible Loading label.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:variant` | `:line \| :box \| :circle \| :heading` | – | Shape and default size. |
| `:class` | `string` | – | Size it with utilities (w-full) or a custom class. |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `skeleton-classes`

Class string for {:variant}.

### `skeleton-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Announces Loading once; mark the surrounding region aria-busy while skeletons show.

## Motion

- A slow pulse loops while visible; reduced motion stops it.

## Responsive behavior

- Skeletons take the dimensions of the content they stand in for; match the final layout.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Build the skeleton in the final layout with the same dimensions, not a generic block.

## Related

- [Spinner](spinner.md): An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color.
- [Progress](progress.md): Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.
- [Empty state](empty-state.md): A centered placeholder with an optional icon for lists and views that have nothing to show yet.

## Guidance for AI tools

Skeleton: Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Spinner

> An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color.

- Type: Component (feedback, Status)
- Namespace: `ui.spinner`
- Source: `src/ui/spinner.cljc`
- Public fns: `spinner-class-list`, `spinner-classes`, `spinner`
- Keywords: spinner, loading, indeterminate, busy

## When to use

- Short waits with no layout to reserve: inside a button, next to a label, in a toolbar.
- Unknown duration.

## When not to use

- Use skeleton to reserve space for content that is loading.
- Use progress when the completion is known.
- Prefer button :loading over placing a spinner next to a button.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.spinner :as spinner])

(spinner/spinner {:size :sm})
```

## API reference

### `spinner`

A <span> with role=status and a Loading label; the ring uses currentColor.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:size` | `:xs \| :sm \| :md \| :lg` | `:md` |  |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – | Override aria-label with something specific. |

### `spinner-classes`

Class string for {:size}.

### `spinner-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Announces Loading once via role=status; pass a specific aria-label when several spinners are on screen.

## Motion

- Spins continuously; reduced motion stops the rotation (the ring stays visible).

## Responsive behavior

- Sizes are fixed; :sm fits inside a button, :lg centers in an empty region.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Inside a button use the button's :loading prop; it picks the right size and color.

## Related

- [Skeleton](skeleton.md): Reserves space with a pulsing placeholder while content loads.
- [Progress](progress.md): Shows how much of a known task is complete as a filled track.
- [Button](button.md): A single action with quiet secondary states, press feedback and a loading spinner.

## Guidance for AI tools

Spinner: An indeterminate loading indicator in four sizes that inherits the current text color. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Switch

> A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately.

- Type: Component (inputs, Selection)
- Namespace: `ui.switch`
- Source: `src/ui/switch.cljc`
- Public fns: `switch-class-list`, `switch-classes`, `switch-toggle`
- Keywords: toggle, switch, on off, setting, checkbox alternative

## When to use

- A binary setting that applies as soon as it changes (notifications on, dark mode).
- Rows in a settings list where the control sits at the end of the row.

## When not to use

- Use form-checkbox inside a form that is submitted later, or for agree and include choices.
- Use button-group or tabs to switch between views of the same content.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.switch :as switch])

(switch/switch-toggle {:checked notifications?
                       :label "Email notifications"
                       :on-change #(toggle! :notifications)})
```

## Examples

### Disabled

```clojure
(switch/switch-toggle {:checked true :disabled true :label "Managed by your admin"})
```

## API reference

### `switch-toggle`

A <label> wrapping a hidden checkbox, a track and a thumb, plus the label text.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:checked` | `boolean` | – | On or off. |
| `:disabled` | `boolean` | – | Disables the input; the attribute is emitted only when true. |
| `:on-change` | `fn` | – | Change handler on :cljs and :squint. |
| `:label` | `string` | – | Visible label next to the track. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `switch-classes`

Class string for {:disabled}.

### `switch-class-list`

Vector form.

## Keyboard interactions

| Keys | Action |
| --- | --- |
| Space | Toggles the switch. |
| Tab | Moves focus to the hidden checkbox; the ring shows on the control. |

## Accessibility

- Built on a real checkbox input, so state is exposed natively.
- Always pass :label; a switch without a visible label needs an aria-label via :attrs.

## Motion

- Track color and thumb position animate over --duration-standard; reduced motion snaps.

## Responsive behavior

- The track is a fixed 40 by 22px target inside a taller label hit area.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Uncontrolled: the browser tracks the state. Submit it with a form or wire :attrs {:onchange "..."}.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: Controlled: pass :checked from state and update it in :on-change.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Controlled; :disabled is omitted when falsy so Eucalypt does not disable the input.

## Notes for AI

- A switch applies immediately; if the page has a Save button, use form-checkbox instead.
- Put the label on the left and the switch on the right in settings rows.

## Related

- [Form](form.md): Labeled fields, inputs, textareas, checkboxes, radios, file and range inputs, joined groups and a search bar.
- [Button group](button-group.md): Related actions as one segmented control: ghost or boxed, with icon items, counts and separators.
- [Tabs](tabs.md): Switch between peer panels of one object, with no JS: hidden radios drive the panels.

## Guidance for AI tools

Switch: A toggle for a setting that takes effect immediately. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt

# Table

> Records in columns from a headers vector and row vectors, with striped and bordered variants.

- Type: Component (data, Collections)
- Namespace: `ui.table`
- Source: `src/ui/table.cljc`
- Public fns: `table-class-list`, `table-classes`, `table`
- Keywords: table, data table, rows, columns, records

## When to use

- Structured records with the same fields per row that people compare across columns.
- Admin and settings lists with a handful of columns.

## When not to use

- Use card-list for one-column lists of options or settings rows.
- Use file-browser for files and folders with grid and list views.
- For sortable or filterable data, add controls above the table; sorting is not built in yet.

## Usage

```clojure
(require '[ui.table :as table])

(table/table {:variant :striped
              :headers ["Name" "Email" "Role"]
              :rows [["Alice Johnson" "alice@example.com" (badge/badge {:variant :success} "Active")]
                     ["Bob Smith" "bob@example.com" "Editor"]]})
```

## Examples

### Bordered, inside a card

```clojure
(card/card {:class "card-flush"}
  (table/table {:variant :bordered :headers ["Key" "Value"] :rows rows}))
```

## API reference

### `table`

Renders <table> inside a .table-wrapper that scrolls horizontally when the columns overflow.

| Prop | Type | Default | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `:headers` | `vector` | – | Column header cells (strings or hiccup). |
| `:rows` | `vector of vectors` | – | Each row is a vector of cell values (strings or hiccup). |
| `:variant` | `nil \| :striped \| :bordered` | – | Zebra rows, or a bordered rounded frame. |
| `:class` | `string` | – |  |
| `:attrs` | `map` | – |  |

### `table-classes`

Class string for {:variant}.

### `table-class-list`

Vector form.

## Accessibility

- Real <table>, <thead> and <th> markup, so screen readers get column headers.
- Put status in a badge with a word, never color alone.

## Motion

- Row hover tint over --duration-fast.

## Responsive behavior

- Wide tables scroll inside the wrapper, not the page. On phones consider a card-list per record instead.

## Targets

- **Hiccup (`:clj`)**: Static markup.
- **Replicant (`:cljs`)**: :class may be a vector.
- **Squint (`:squint`)**: Static markup.

## Notes for AI

- Numbers that align in a column get class tabular-nums and right alignment.
- Headers are sentence case.

## Related

- [Card](card.md): A bordered surface that groups related content and actions, plus a divided list variant.
- [File browser](file-browser.md): Grid tiles and a sortable list or table of files and folders with type icons, selection and per-item context menus.
- [Pagination](pagination.md): Move through a long collection with numbered pages and previous and next links.
- [Badge](badge.md): A small pill for status, category or a count, with an optional leading icon.

## Guidance for AI tools

Table: Records in columns from a headers vector and row vectors, with striped and bordered variants. Use only the documented props; `:class` and `:attrs` are for layout and extra attributes, never for restyling internals. The same call renders on all three targets; see Targets for the per-target event and class conventions. Keep keyboard access and both themes intact.

Full library index: docs/llms.txt
